description: x402 Payment Debugger: Offline diagnosis of an x402 X-PAYMENT payload: recompute the EIP-712 TransferWithAuthorization digest, recover the secp256k1 signer, compare it with authorization.from, then check payee, amount and the validAfter/validBefore window. Returns verdict (valid_offline|signer_mismatch|expired|not_yet_valid|terms_mismatch|malformed), per-field checks[], fixes[] and recovered_signer. No RPC needed, so the answer always comes back. Input: {"payment": "<base64 X-PAYMENT header or decoded object>", "expect": {"payTo":"0x...","amount":20000,"asset":"0x8335...2913"}}  Method: POST
name: x402-publish-1794540499380-x402-payment-debugge
